inputs: text-only Studio automatic readings; saved vocal audio, emissions and acoustic segmentation; no reference times/readings during inference
unknown_policy: strict complete delivery blocked; separately diagnosed partial run omits empty reading and preserves explicit unresolved marker
dp: current Lazulite align_lines default config: max 4 lines / 2 acoustic segments
pseudo_evidence: assign each global unit to core with greatest overlap; reject no-overlap units; CTC timing used as pseudo evidence, not independent transcript
independent_evidence: NextFire greedy argmax CTC characters within same acoustic cores
grouping: adjacent DP rows sharing source segments grouped, capped at 4 lines; use acoustic segment padded envelopes plus 0.10s; no human window
candidate_guard: nonempty path; all units positive; all units <=2s except final unit <=3s; weighted acoustic-core coverage >=0.70; aggregate mean character confidence not >0.05 lower than incumbent; <=2s boundary displacement unless incumbent has >3s unit or <0.70 coverage
acceptance: update only if acoustic coverage improves >=0.03 or longest unit falls >=0.20s or confidence improves >=0.01; otherwise keep incumbent
convergence: stop when max boundary displacement <20ms, or after 3 rounds
selection: evaluate all fixed variants and rounds; no reference-based candidate selection or hyperparameter tuning
